entity.description: Ted Lasso is a 2020 comedy-drama sports series developed by Jason Sudeikis, Bill Lawrence, Brendan Hunt and Joe Kelly. The show follows an upbeat American college football coach who is unexpectedly hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English Premier League club, and chronicles his unorthodox, empathetic approach to leadership as he transforms players, staff and the owner while confronting personal challenges. The series stars Jason Sudeikis alongside Hannah Waddingham, Brendan Hunt, Juno Temple, Jeremy Swift, Brett Goldstein, Phil Dunster, Nick Mohammed and Toheeb Jimoh. Across intimate character arcs and ensemble-driven storylines the show explores themes of teamwork, redemption, cultural clashes, mental health and the power of kindness, blending broad comedy with sincere drama and an overall uplifting emotional tone.

entity.name: Jamie xx
entity.description: Jamie xx (Jamie Smith) is an English electronic music producer, DJ and member of the band The xx. Rising to attention as The xx's producer and instrumental backbone, he has built a parallel solo career producing club-focused, sample-driven electronic music that bridges UK garage, post-dubstep and indie sensibilities. His debut solo album In Colour (2015) received wide acclaim for its textured production and nostalgic, dancefloor-ready compositions. He is also known for his remixes and production work, notably reworking Gil Scott-Heron's material for the 2011 project We're New Here, and for bringing an understated, melancholic tone to contemporary club music.

via: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett

entity.name: Sampha
entity.description: Sampha (Sampha Sisay) is a British singer, songwriter, keyboardist and producer celebrated for fragile, emotionally charged vocals and sparse, artful production that blends soul, R&B and electronic music. He emerged from the South London scene as a sought-after collaborator and remixer before releasing his Mercury Prize–winning debut album Process (2017). Alongside his solo work he has contributed to recordings by SBTRKT, Jessie Ware, Drake, Beyoncé, Kanye West, Frank Ocean and many others, becoming a pivotal figure in contemporary British alternative R&B and electronic-soul.

via: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett
